overview: The committee recognized a student hero and the award-winning robotics team before reviewing a $320,000 vocational technical grant for metal fabrication equipment. They also approved several policy resolutions regarding Title IX transparency, anti-discrimination updates, and a follow-up meeting on the high school safety and climate review.

items.title: Consent Agenda and Subcommittee Reports
items.summary: Approved bills, payroll, and minutes from previous regular and subcommittee meetings.

items.title: Mustang Hero Award
items.summary: Honored 11th-grade student Kenneth Thompson Rodriguez for his quick response in performing the Heimlich maneuver on a fellow student.

items.title: Robotics Team Recognition
items.summary: Recognized the Medford Vocational Technical High School robotics team for winning the New England regionals and qualifying for the world championships in Colorado.

items.title: Superintendent's Updates
items.summary: Announced the appointment of Miss Cabral as the new Medford High School principal and highlighted various district events, including Haitian Flag Day, Special Olympics, and a garden grant for Roberts Elementary.

items.title: CCSR Outreach Plan 2023-2024
items.summary: Reviewed a plan to increase student participation in the Center for Citizenship and Social Responsibility, which includes launching a Summer Leadership Academy and restoring an elective class.

items.title: Capital Skills Grant for Metal Fabrication
items.summary: Presented details of a $320,000 grant used to outfit the metal fabrication and welding shop with modern industrial machinery.

items.title: Resolution on Anti-Discrimination Policy Review
items.summary: Approved a resolution for the Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Subcommittee to review and update district policies on harassment and retaliation based on state association samples.

items.title: Title IX Transparency and Website Updates
items.summary: Approved a resolution requiring the district website and student handbooks to clearly display Title IX policies, reporting procedures, and coordinator contact information.

items.title: MHS Safety and Climate Review Follow-up
items.summary: Approved a motion to convene a Committee of the Whole meeting with consultant Michael J. Welch to discuss his security and climate review of the high school complex.

items.title: Standardized Disability Accommodation Statement
items.summary: Approved a resolution requiring a standardized accommodation statement on all school activity forms and policies, with an amendment regarding the specification of wheelchair accessibility.
